Rotations are in full turns (1 means one 360° rotation on that axis). Viewed from tail toward nose: kickflip is positive long, heelflip negative long, frontside positive vertical, backside negative vertical, nose-forward positive cross. This trick needs at least 0.8 s to finish. Set landsWheelsDown true only when the long- and cross-axis turns are whole numbers; set canFlipFinishInAir true only when the airtime meets that minimum. Return only JSON: {"rotations":{"long":number,"vertical":number,"cross":number},"airtimeS":number,"peakHeightM":number,"landsWheelsDown":boolean,"canFlipFinishInAir":boolean}. Round calculated values to three decimals.
